summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong Listing Rules, detailing ongoing share repurchases from April 1–24, 2026. The issuer repurchased daily tranches of WVR ordinary shares at prices $4.92–$5.50 per share, with aggregates for each date listed. Shares are bought for cancellation but remain uncancelled as of the closing balance. There is no board recommendation disclosed, as this is a routine disclosure of open-market buybacks under an existing program. The filing confirms a capital-return strategy, with no premium over market. Watch for completion of the buyback authorization and potential further reductions in shares outstanding.
